sentences.text:
(Lodged In Central Jail, Jodhpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Bhagirath Ray Bishnoi For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, PP  Mr. Deepak Bansal, for the  complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/08/2023

This application for bail has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. in connection with FIR No.62/2023 Police Station Kaparda, District Jodhpur, for the offences under Sections 323, 354, 506, 376/G of IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the allegation against the present petitioner is that he tried to sexually assault the prosecutrix.
Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel further submitted that co-accused-Sohan Lal @ Sethi S/o Bhakar Ram has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 25.07.2023 (S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8346/2023).

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.8346/2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submitted that there is no apprehension of the present petitioner influencing the witness or tampering with the evidence.

Learned counsel submitted that (2 of 2) [CRLMB-9848/2023] challan against the present petitioner has already been filed; the petitioner is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail application.
However, they were not in position to refute the fact that aforementioned co- accused has already been enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that co-accused- Sohan Lal @ Sethi has already been enlarged on bail by this Court and looking to the possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that petitioner-Kalu Ram S/o Shri Jagdish Ram, arrested in connection with FIR No.62/2023 Police Station Kaparda, District Jodhpur; provided he executes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
Petitioner shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 149-KshamaD/-
